source.text_it: In un motore Diesel è indifferente usare olii per motori a benzina, purché siano abbastanza densi

records.localized_text: Petrol-engine oils can be used interchangeably in a diesel engine provided they are thick enough.

source.text_it: Il manometro posto sul cruscotto indica la quantità di olio contenuto dalla coppa

records.localized_text: The dashboard pressure gauge indicates the amount of oil in the sump.

source.text_it: La spia luminosa della lubrificazione si accende quando la coppa dell’olio è vuota

records.localized_text: The lubrication warning light comes on when the oil sump is empty.

source.text_it: Se si accende la spia della lubrificazione, significa che l’olio è alla corretta temperatura

records.localized_text: If the lubrication warning light comes on, the oil is at the correct temperature.

source.text_it: Se si accende la spia della lubrificazione, significa che bisogna cambiare l’olio entro cinquemila chilometri

records.localized_text: If the lubrication warning light comes on, the oil must be changed within five thousand kilometres.

source.text_it: Se dal tubo di scarico di un motore Diesel esce fumo nero, significa che sta bruciando olio

records.localized_text: Black smoke from a diesel exhaust means it is burning oil.

source.text_it: Se il filtro dell’olio è sporco, dal tubo di scarico esce fumo rossastro

records.localized_text: If the oil filter is dirty, reddish smoke comes from the exhaust.

source.text_it: E' buona regola scaricare periodicamente l’olio dal motore, filtrarlo con un panno pulito e, successivamente, rimetterlo nella coppa

records.localized_text: It is good practice to periodically drain engine oil, filter it through a clean cloth and return it to the sump.

source.text_it: Se il motore consuma molto olio significa che nei cilindri si ha troppa pressione

records.localized_text: If an engine consumes much oil, cylinder pressure is too high.

source.text_it: A differenza di quello di lubrificazione del motore, l’olio del cambio non si sostituisce mai perché non è soggetto a forte riscaldamento

records.localized_text: Unlike engine lubricating oil, gearbox oil is never changed because it is not subject to high heat.

source.text_it: Una delle principali trasformazioni che subiscono gli olii lubrificanti durante l’uso è l’aumento di salinità

records.localized_text: One major change in lubricating oil during use is increased salinity.

source.text_it: La spia luminosa della lubrificazione si accende quando la temperatura dell’olio supera i 100°C

records.localized_text: The lubrication warning light comes on when oil temperature exceeds 100°C.

source.text_it: Quando l’olio motore è troppo denso è bene aggiungere olio vegetale

records.localized_text: When engine oil is too thick, vegetable oil should be added.

source.text_it: Se la temperatura dell’aria è molto bassa, è bene aggiungere all’olio di lubrificazione un poco di benzina (non più del 5%)

records.localized_text: If air temperature is very low, add a little petrol, no more than 5%, to lubricating oil.

source.text_it: Il lubrificante comincia a circolare nel motore solo dopo che la temperatura dell’acqua ha superato i 65°C

records.localized_text: Lubricant starts circulating in the engine only after water temperature exceeds 65°C.

source.text_it: Per raffreddare l’olio motore, una valvola di intercettazione lo fa passare nel radiatore dell’acqua quando supera i 120°C

records.localized_text: To cool engine oil, a shutoff valve directs it through the water radiator when it exceeds 120°C.

source.text_it: La coppa dell’olio contiene un dispositivo per raffreddare l’olio

records.localized_text: The oil sump contains an oil-cooling device.

source.text_it: L’impianto di lubrificazione è utile per evitare il blocco degli iniettori intasati

records.localized_text: The lubrication system helps prevent blocked injectors from seizing.

source.text_it: Il rabbocco di olio lubrificante in un motore Diesel non è consentito, se il livello è basso occorre sostituirlo completamente

records.localized_text: Diesel engine lubricating oil may not be topped up; if low, it must be completely replaced.

source.text_it: Se l’olio nel motore è troppo denso, si deve rimediare aggiungendo una certa quantità di gasolio

records.localized_text: If engine oil is too thick, add some diesel fuel.

source.text_it: L’olio di lubrificazione deve essere sostituito ogni due mesi

records.localized_text: Lubricating oil must be changed every two months.

source.text_it: L’olio di lubrificazione di un motore Diesel deve essere sostituito solo quando è diventato molto scuro

records.localized_text: Diesel engine lubricating oil must be changed only when it becomes very dark.

source.text_it: La cartuccia del filtro dell’olio va sostituita solo quando si accende la spia rossa sul cruscotto

records.localized_text: The oil filter cartridge must be replaced only when the red dashboard warning light comes on.

source.text_it: L’olio lubrificante del cambio e del differenziale devono essere sostituiti ad ogni cambio di olio del motore

records.localized_text: Gearbox and differential lubricating oil must be changed whenever engine oil is changed.

source.text_it: L’olio esausto deve generalmente essere bruciato in un luogo lontano dal veicolo e dai centri abitati

records.localized_text: Used oil must generally be burned away from the vehicle and built-up areas.

rows.text: Viscosity alone is not enough: use oil that also meets the manufacturer’s specifications for that diesel engine. Some oils meet both diesel and gasoline specifications.
evidence: API Motor Oil Guide, pp. 1–2, https://www.api.org/-/media/files/certification/engine-oil-diesel/%20publications/motor%20oil%20guide%201020.pdf: viscosity and service category are separate; follow manufacturer recommendations.

rows.text: The gauge shows oil pressure, not the amount in the sump. Check the level with the dipstick or the vehicle’s specified system.
evidence: Cummins CFP59 service manual, section 7 p. 181, https://mart.cummins.com/imagelibrary/data/assetfiles/0057239.pdf: gauge indicates oil pressure after starting; dipstick checks level.

rows.text: The oil pressure light warns of insufficient pressure: it can come on even if the sump is not empty. If the engine is running, stop and switch it off.
evidence: Jeep Cherokee 2022 Owner’s Manual, p. 85, https://ownersmanuals2.com/jeep/cherokee-2022-owners-manual-86637/page-87: oil pressure warning indicates low pressure and requires stopping engine and checking level.

rows.text: The oil pressure light warns of insufficient pressure, not a correct temperature. If it comes on while driving, stop and switch off the engine.
evidence: Jeep Cherokee 2022 Owner’s Manual, p. 85, https://ownersmanuals2.com/jeep/cherokee-2022-owners-manual-86637/page-87: oil pressure warning indicates low pressure and requires stopping engine and checking level.

rows.text: The pressure light signals a problem needing immediate attention, not an oil change due in 5,000 km. Stop, switch off the engine and check the level.
evidence: Jeep Cherokee 2022 Owner’s Manual, p. 85, https://ownersmanuals2.com/jeep/cherokee-2022-owners-manual-86637/page-87: oil pressure warning indicates low pressure and requires stopping engine and checking level.

rows.text: Black smoke can result from excess fuel or insufficient air; it does not prove oil is burning. Worn pistons or rings can instead produce blue smoke.
evidence: Cummins Onan HDK service manual, Troubleshooting p. B-6, https://www.cummins.com/sites/default/files/2019-11/0981-0178_I7_201009.pdf: black smoke may result from blocked air intake or excess fuel; blue smoke from worn pistons or rings.

rows.text: The filter cleans oil in the lubrication circuit; a blockage is not indicated by reddish exhaust smoke. Replace it according to the maintenance schedule.
evidence: Volvo Trucks, preventive maintenance tip 7, https://www.volvotrucks.com/th-th/news/insights/articles/2023/may/top-8-preventive-maintenance-tips-to-avoid-truck-breakdowns.html: replace engine oil filters at service intervals.

https://www.mann-filter.com/content/dam/website/mann-filter/mann-filter-com/en/documents/mann-filter-product-brochure-for-cars-and-transportersr.pdf — MANN-FILTER: il filtro rimuove residui e impurità dall’olio.

rows.text: Used oil must be replaced with new oil specified by the manufacturer. Filtering it through a cloth and returning it to the sump is not an oil change.
evidence: Cummins service manual 0981-0516, p. 8-3, https://www.cummins.com/sites/default/files/2024-10/0981-0516-i9-hdkag-service-manual.pdf: replace oil and filter at prescribed intervals, refill with new oil of specified grade.

rows.text: High oil consumption does not prove excessive cylinder pressure: worn piston rings, for example, can cause it. The cause needs diagnosis.
evidence: MAHLE Engine Component and Filters Failure Guide, section 6.3 p. 38, https://www.mahle-aftermarket.com/media/local-media-north-america/pdfs-%26-thumbnails/mahle-engine-component-%26-filters-failure-guide.pdf: ring wear can increase oil consumption.

rows.text: Gearbox oil may also require replacement according to the manufacturer’s schedule. Transmission components heat up in operation.
evidence: Volvo Trucks Service Contracts, https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/services/workshop-and-uptime-services/service-contracts.html: preventive maintenance includes gearbox and axle oil changes in a usage-based schedule; Freightliner Cargo Maintenance Manual, 35-03, https://dtnacontent-dtna.prd.freightliner.com/content/dam/public/dtna-servicelit/dtna/pdfs/en_us/freightliner/drivers-manuals/Cargo%20Maintenance%20Manual_.pdf: axle lubricant schedules depend on service and operating temperature can be high.

Freightliner Cargo Maintenance Manual, Jan 2000, section 35-03, printed p. 35/2 (PDF p. 67), https://dtnacontent-dtna.prd.freightliner.com/content/dam/public/dtna-servicelit/dtna/pdfs/en_us/freightliner/drivers-manuals/Cargo%20Maintenance%20Manual_.pdf — axle oil operating temperatures and change frequency under high temperature; model-specific example. Exact local inspection copy /tmp/rotonda-freightliner-cargo-maintenance.pdf SHA256 9df21b2f7e966663193e8373296dd2f3f44e780f3367814832d188c25805c8f6. Printed p.26/4 (PDF p.46) likewise specifies operating temperature for Allison transmission fluid.

rows.text: During use, oil can oxidize and become contaminated, for example by soot or fuel. Increased salinity is not the main change described.
evidence: Caterpillar S·O·S Services, https://www.cat.com/en_US/support/maintenance/sos-services/take-sample.html: oil oxidation and contaminants including soot and fuel are monitored; fuel contamination can lower viscosity.

rows.text: The oil pressure light warns of insufficient pressure, not a temperature above 100°C. If it comes on while driving, stop and switch off the engine.
evidence: Jeep Cherokee 2022 Owner’s Manual, p. 85, https://ownersmanuals2.com/jeep/cherokee-2022-owners-manual-86637/page-87: oil pressure warning indicates low pressure and requires stopping engine and checking level.

rows.text: Do not add vegetable oil: use engine oil with the viscosity and specifications prescribed by the manufacturer for the operating conditions.
evidence: API Motor Oil Guide, pp. 1–2, https://www.api.org/-/media/files/certification/engine-oil-diesel/%20publications/motor%20oil%20guide%201020.pdf: viscosity and service category are separate; follow manufacturer recommendations.

rows.text: Do not add gasoline to oil, even a little: fuel contaminates it and can reduce its viscosity. Choose the prescribed grade for cold conditions.
evidence: API Motor Oil Guide, pp. 1–2, https://www.api.org/-/media/files/certification/engine-oil-diesel/%20publications/motor%20oil%20guide%201020.pdf: viscosity and service category are separate; follow manufacturer recommendations.

Caterpillar S·O·S Services, https://www.cat.com/en_US/support/maintenance/sos-services/take-sample.html: oil oxidation and contaminants including soot and fuel are monitored; fuel contamination can lower viscosity.

rows.text: The pump must pressurize oil soon after starting, without waiting for the coolant to reach 65°C. Check pressure immediately.
evidence: Cummins CFP59 service manual, section 7 p. 181, https://mart.cummins.com/imagelibrary/data/assetfiles/0057239.pdf: gauge indicates oil pressure after starting; dipstick checks level.

rows.text: There is no general rule that oil passes through the water radiator at 120°C. A heat exchanger can cool oil while keeping it separate from coolant.
evidence: Audi Engine Mechanics, oil cooling p. 20, https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2015/MC-10124696-9999.pdf: engine oil cooler is an oil/coolant heat exchanger on the engine, not oil flowing through the water radiator at a universal 120°C threshold.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSO: the sump collects oil returning from the engine; in some engines the oil cooler is separate. Other designs, however, integrate a cooler into the sump.
evidence: https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2015/MC-10124696-9999.pdf — Audi 1.4 TFSI pp.19–20: coppa e scambiatore olio/liquido su blocco motore.

https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/hondatechnicalreview/23/2/23_2011_23_2_5/_supplement/_download/23_2011_23_2_5_1.pdf — Honda Technical Review 2011 p.34 fig.9: raffreddatore integrato in coppa per generatore fisso, non veicolo.

rows.text: The lubrication circuit carries oil to moving parts to reduce friction and help cool them. It does not unblock clogged injectors.
evidence: https://www.mann-filter.com/content/dam/website/mann-filter/mann-filter-com/en/documents/mann-filter-product-brochure-for-cars-and-transportersr.pdf — MANN-FILTER: il filtro rimuove residui e impurità dall’olio.

Perkins 4008-30 Industrial Engine, Systems Operation M0064276, printed pp. 7–8 and p. 10, https://s7d2.scene7.com/is/content/Caterpillar/C10852360 — oil supply to bearings and piston cooling circuit; piston jets cool pistons. Industrial diesel example.

rows.text: If the level is low, top up with the specified oil, observing the indicated level. Topping up does not replace the scheduled oil change.
evidence: Hyundai Elantra 2025 Owner’s Manual p. 85, https://ownersmanuals2.com/hyundai/elantra-2025-owners-manual-99976/page-85: check and top up low engine oil; oil pressure warning indicates low pressure.

Cummins service manual 0981-0516, p. 8-3, https://www.cummins.com/sites/default/files/2024-10/0981-0516-i9-hdkag-service-manual.pdf: replace oil and filter at prescribed intervals, refill with new oil of specified grade.

rows.text: Do not add diesel fuel to oil: fuel contaminates it and can reduce its viscosity. Use oil of the required grade and specification.
evidence: Caterpillar S·O·S Services, https://www.cat.com/en_US/support/maintenance/sos-services/take-sample.html: oil oxidation and contaminants including soot and fuel are monitored; fuel contamination can lower viscosity.

API Motor Oil Guide, pp. 1–2, https://www.api.org/-/media/files/certification/engine-oil-diesel/%20publications/motor%20oil%20guide%201020.pdf: viscosity and service category are separate; follow manufacturer recommendations.

rows.text: There is no universal two-month interval. Oil changes depend on the engine and its operating conditions: follow the manufacturer’s schedule.
evidence: Cummins B6.7 Truck Maintenance and Operation, maintenance intervals, https://mart.cummins.com/imagelibrary/data/assetfiles/0059586.pdf: oil drain interval depends on duty and oil pan; manufacturer lists time, mileage and hours.

rows.text: Dark color alone does not determine when to change oil. Follow the prescribed intervals and, where applicable, oil analysis recommendations.
evidence: Shell AeroShell Book 2021, Oil Colour, https://www.shell.com/business-customers/aviation/aeroshell/knowledge-centre/the-aeroshell-book/_jcr_content/root/main/section/call_to_action/links/item0.stream/1661865089178/532117a417be92af6b0a951a304ada955d588ce5/theaeroshellbook-edition2021.pdf: dispersant oil can darken while still usable; change by servicing requirement, not colour; Cummins B6.7 guide https://mart.cummins.com/imagelibrary/data/assetfiles/0059586.pdf gives diesel service intervals.
Cummins oil analysis, https://shop.cummins.com/SC/product/standard-oil-smp/01t4N0000048p3JQAQ: degradation and contamination monitoring helps determine oil change intervals.

rows.text: Replace the oil filter at the scheduled intervals without waiting for the red light. The pressure light signals a condition requiring immediate attention.
evidence: Volvo Trucks, preventive maintenance tip 7, https://www.volvotrucks.com/th-th/news/insights/articles/2023/may/top-8-preventive-maintenance-tips-to-avoid-truck-breakdowns.html: replace engine oil filters at service intervals.

Jeep Cherokee 2022 Owner’s Manual, p. 85, https://ownersmanuals2.com/jeep/cherokee-2022-owners-manual-86637/page-87: oil pressure warning indicates low pressure and requires stopping engine and checking level.

rows.text: The gearbox and differential have their own maintenance schedules: their oils need not be changed at every engine oil change. Follow the vehicle’s intervals.
evidence: Volvo Trucks Service Contracts, https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/services/workshop-and-uptime-services/service-contracts.html: preventive maintenance includes gearbox and axle oil changes in a usage-based schedule; Freightliner Cargo Maintenance Manual, 35-03, https://dtnacontent-dtna.prd.freightliner.com/content/dam/public/dtna-servicelit/dtna/pdfs/en_us/freightliner/drivers-manuals/Cargo%20Maintenance%20Manual_.pdf: axle lubricant schedules depend on service and operating temperature can be high.

Cummins B6.7 Truck Maintenance and Operation, maintenance intervals, https://mart.cummins.com/imagelibrary/data/assetfiles/0059586.pdf: oil drain interval depends on duty and oil pan; manufacturer lists time, mileage and hours.

rows.text: Collect used oil and take it to an authorized collection facility for management or recovery; do not burn it outdoors. It can contain contaminants.
evidence: US EPA, Managing, Reusing and Recycling Used Oil, https://www.epa.gov/recycle/managing-reusing-and-recycling-used-oil: collect used oil for recycling; it can contain harmful contaminants and must be managed properly.

issues.reason: Il quesito afferma senza specificare il motore che la coppa contiene un dispositivo di raffreddamento; il verdetto stampato è FALSO, ma esistono configurazioni reali con scambiatore nella coppa o nel serbatoio. Non è specificata una configurazione che consenta di conciliare il verdetto con tali esempi.
checked_sources: Honda R&D Technical Review, October 2011, section 3.2.2 and fig. 9, https://global.honda/en/technical-review/PDF/023-2/Vol.23-2e.pdf: 2006 engine has a coil oil cooler inside the oil tank; 2011 engine has a cooler integrated with oil pan.

Audi Engine Mechanics, oil cooling p. 20, https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2015/MC-10124696-9999.pdf: an automotive engine places an oil/coolant cooler on the cylinder block, separately from the sump.

issues.reason: The MANN filter brochure supports filtration, not the explanation of oil delivery to moving parts and cooling. Add a directly supporting source such as the Perkins 4008-30 system manual pp.7–8: https://s7d2.scene7.com/is/content/Caterpillar/C10852360.

The Freightliner Cargo maintenance PDF timed out during independent review; it is the cited source for heat and maintenance of the axle lubricant. Provide the exact locally accessible document or another inspected source.
